map.Aw = 食品中水蒸汽压 / 纯水蒸汽压: Aw = water vapour pressure in the food / pure water vapour pressure
map.水分活度 Aw = 食品中水蒸汽压 / 纯水蒸汽压，反映微生物可利用的水。Aw: Water activity Aw = water vapour pressure in the food divided by pure water vapour pressure, reflecting the water available to microorganisms. The lower the Aw the more stable the product. Most bacteria need Aw above 0.9, yeast above 0.85 and moulds above 0.7; halophiles above 0.75 and osmotolerant yeast above 0.62. Lowering Aw (drying, salting, sugaring) is a classic preservation method.
map.📚 深度解析：水分活度（Aw）与微生物风险: 📚 In-depth analysis: Water Activity (Aw) and Microbial Risk
map.Aw = 食品水蒸气压 ÷ 纯水蒸气压（0–1）；微生物生长阈值：Aw<0.60: Aw = water vapour pressure of the food divided by that of pure water (0-1); growth thresholds: most organisms do not grow below Aw 0.60, yeasts and moulds grow between 0.60 and 0.85, and bacteria above 0.85.
map.Aw=0.85：处于细菌可生长下限、酵母/霉菌易长区间，需配合降低 Aw（脱水/: Aw=0.85 sits at the lower limit for bacteria and in the easy range for yeasts and moulds, so it needs a lower Aw (dehydration, sugar or salt), preservatives or refrigeration; going below 0.85 noticeably inhibits bacteria.
map.Aw 和含水量一样吗？: Is Aw the same as water content?
map.不同。含水量是绝对水，Aw 是可供微生物利用的自由水，受糖盐束缚影响。: No. Water content is absolute water, while Aw is the free water available to microorganisms and is affected by binding from sugars and salts.
map.脱水、加糖/盐降低自由水、用保湿剂（甘油/山梨醇）并配合防腐剂与包装。: Dehydrate, add sugar or salt to bind free water, use humectants (glycerol or sorbitol) and combine with preservatives and packaging.
